newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM load factor rises in April.
newsitem.headline: KLM load factor rises in April.

text.p: Provisional traffic and load factor figures from KLM Royal Dutch Airlines
KLM said it had adjusted its standards for calculating capacity tonne-kilometres with effect from April 1, 1997.
The adjustments concern the standard average weight of baggage and cargo. The standard weight used for baggage per passenger has been raised from 14 to 21 kilograms in line with competing airlines.
Cargo capacity calculations are now more closely based on the actual capacity available for transporting air freight, resulting in an approximately five percent drop in cargo capacity, KLM said.
The airline said that on balance, the adjustments have produced an overall decline in total available tonne-kilometres of approximately one percent.
The 1996 figures have been adjusted for ease of comparison, KLM added.
